evidence.snippet: Publish your app in the Shopify App Store and any merchant can install it once it passes review.
A custom app takes the other path: one organization installs it directly, with no listing and no review.

decisions.reason: Developers can self-serve build/test with free Partner/Dev Dashboard accounts, but public, multi-merchant distribution requires Shopify's App Store review process.

evidence.snippet: reviews your listing before it goes live. Read the requirements before you submit, because a rejection costs you a full review cycle.

decisions.reason: A toolkit can be built and tested today with free Dev Dashboard/Partner credentials, but scaling to many merchants requires passing Shopify's app review, so it's ready with caveats rather than fully unrestricted.
